title.ja: 二千年後の君へ シガンシナ陥落①
title.en: To You, 2000 Years in the Future: The Fall of Zhiganshina (1)
title.de: An dich in 2000 Jahren – Der Fall von Shiganshina, Teil 1
title.fr: À toi qui vis 2000 ans plus tard
title.es: A ti, dentro de 2000 años. La caída de Shiganshina (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Nisen-nengo no Kimi e: Shiganshina Kanraku (1)

1.overview: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.
1.summary:
After 100 years, peace is broken by the appearance of a fifty meter tall Titan.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: その日 シガンシナ陥落②
title.en: That Day: The Fall of Zhiganshina (2)
title.de: An jenem Tag – Der Fall von Shiganshina, Teil 2
title.fr: Ce jour-là ~2) La chute de Shiganshina~
title.es: Aquel día. La caída de Shiganshina (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Sono Hi: Zhiganshina Kanraku (2)

2.overview: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.
2.summary:
As Titans continue to rampage, the townspeople gather at the inner gate. But a new Titan breaks through and this one is unlike the others.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 絶望の中で鈍く光る 人類の再起①
title.en: A Dim Light in the Darkness of Despair: Humanity Rises Again (1)
title.de: Ein fahles Licht inmitten der Verzweiflung – Die Rückkehr der Menschheit, Teil 1
title.fr: Une faible étincelle dans le désespoir ~Le réveil de l`humanité~
title.es: Una tenue luz en la desesperación. La restauración de la humanidad (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Zetsubou no Naka de Nibuku Hikaru: Jinrui no Saiki (1)

3.overview: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertholdt and Reiner offer kindly advice.
3.summary:
Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Berholt and Reiner offer kindly advice.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 解散式の夜 人類の再起②
title.en: Night of the Graduation Ceremony: Humanity Rises Again (2)
title.de: Die Nacht der Abschlusszeremonie – Die Rückkehr der Menschheit, Teil 2
title.fr: Le soir de la cérémonie de fin d`entraînement ~Le réveil de l`humanité~
title.es: La noche de la desbandada. La restauración de la humanidad (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Kaisanshiki no Yoru: Jinrui no Saiki (2)

4.overview: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.
4.summary:
Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jan dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations - along with a sudden outbreak of violence!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 初陣 トロスト区攻防戦①
title.en: First Battle: Battle of Trost (1)
title.de: Feuertaufe – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 1
title.fr: Première bataille ~La lutte pour le district Trost~
title.es: La primera batalla. La defensa de Trost (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Uijin: Trost-ku Koubousen (1)

5.overview: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.
5.summary:
Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere and knocks a strategic hole in the Rose Wall gate. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight in brutal battle that won`t be without casualties.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 少女が見た世界 トロスト区攻防戦②
title.en: The World the Girl Saw: Battle for Trost (2)
title.de: Die Welt durch die Augen eines Mädchens – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 2
title.fr: Une petite lame ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: El mundo que ella vio. La defensa de Trost (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Shoujo ga Mita Sekai: Trost-ku Koubousen (2)

6.overview: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.
6.summary:
Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 小さな刃 トロスト区攻防戦③
title.en: The Small Blade: The Battle for Trost (3)
title.de: Eine kleine Klinge – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 3
title.fr: Courte lame ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Una pequeña hoja. La defensa de Trost (Parte 3)
title.x-jat: Chiisana Yaiba: Trost-ku Koubousen (3)

7.overview: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.
7.summary:
After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin`s squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 心臓の鼓動が聞こえる トロスト区攻防戦④
title.en: Hearing the Heartbeat: The Battle for Trost (4)
title.de: Ich kann seinen Herzschlag hören – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 4
title.fr: J`entends les battements de ton cœur ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Se escucha un latido. La defensa de Trost (Parte 4)
title.x-jat: Shinzou no Kodou ga Kikoeru: Trost-ku Koubousen (4)

8.overview: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.
8.summary:
Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned Cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 左腕の行方 トロスト区攻防戦⑤
title.en: Where the Left Arm Went: The Battle for Trost (5)
title.de: Der Verbleib des linken Arms – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 5
title.fr: Qu`est-il advenu du bras gauche ? ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Dónde está el brazo izquierdo. La defensa de Trost (Parte 5)
title.x-jat: Hidari Ude no Yukue: Trost-ku Koubousen (5)

9.overview: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?
9.summary:
A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a monster and how he ended up humankind`s enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 応える トロスト区攻防戦⑥
title.en: Response: The Battle for Trost (6)
title.de: Die Reaktion – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 6
title.fr: Répondre ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Respuesta. La defensa de Trost (Parte 6)
title.x-jat: Kotaeru: Trost-ku Koubousen (6)

10.overview: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can't talk the commander into using Eren's newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.
10.summary:
Cadets respond to Eren`s terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can`t talk the commander into using Eren`s newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 偶像 トロスト区攻防戦⑦
title.en: Icon: The Battle for Trost (7)
title.de: Das Idol – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 7
title.fr: Idole ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Ídolo. La defensa de Trost (Parte 7)
title.x-jat: Guuzou: Trost-ku Koubousen (7)

11.overview: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.
11.summary:
Plans are created to use Eren`s Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt to reclaim Trost. But with the government`s bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 傷 トロスト区攻防戦⑧
title.en: Wound: The Battle for Trost (8)
title.de: Die Wunde – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 8
title.fr: Blessure ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Herida. La defensa de Trost (Parte 8)
title.x-jat: Kizu: Trost-ku Koubousen (8)

12.overview: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren’s newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it’s up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven’t died in vain.
12.summary:
The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren`s newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it`s up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven`t died in vain.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 原初的欲求 トロスト区攻防戦⑨
title.en: Primal Desires: The Battle for Trost (9)
title.de: Urtrieb – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 9
title.fr: Désir primitif ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Deseos primarios. La defensa de Trost (Parte 9)
title.x-jat: Genshoteki Yokkyuu: Trost-ku Koubousen (9)

13.overview: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity’s first victory against the Titans will be enormous.
13.summary:
Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken maneuvering device. Meanwhile, Eren is able to plug the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity`s first victory against the Titans will be gigantic.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: まだ目を見れない 反撃前夜①
title.en: Still Can`t See: Night Before the Counteroffensive (1)
title.de: Noch nicht fähig, in die Augen zu sehen – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 1
title.fr: On ne peut pas le regarder dans les yeux ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
title.es: Sigo sin poder ver. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Mada Me o Mirenai: Hangeki Zen`ya (1)

14.overview: A special military tribunal will decide Eren’s fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.
14.summary:
The people all react in different ways to the story of Eren`s titan power.  The further inside the walls they live, the more they fear him as a demon that must be destroyed, while those who live near the outside see him as a savior.  The government must decide whether to send him to the Military Police or the Survey Team.  The two groups collide as the Inquiry begins.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 特別作戦班 反撃前夜②
title.en: Special Ops Squad: Night Before the Counteroffensive (2)
title.de: Spezialkommando – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 2
title.fr: Unité d`intervention ~La veille de la contre-attaque~
title.es: El escuadrón de operaciones especiales. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Tokubetsu Sakusen-han: Hangeki Zen`ya (2)

15.overview: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hanzi visits and reveals that she’s been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren’s help with.
15.summary:
After the Inquiry Eren is assigned to the Survey Team`s special operations squad, known as "Squad Levi."  The Squad is composed of the best troops the survey team has, but they`re all very strange people.  With a major mission 30 days away, Eren hears from Hanji about the experiments on the titans from Trost.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 今, 何をすべきか 反撃前夜③
title.en: What Should Be Done: Night Before the Counteroffensive (3)
title.de: Was getan werden muss – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 3
title.fr: Ce qu`il faut faire maintenant ~La veille de la contre-attaque~
title.es: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos?. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 3)
title.x-jat: Ima, Nani o Subeki ka: Hangeki Zen`ya (3)

16.overview: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they’ll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.
16.summary:
The two Titans the Survey Corps captured have been killed by a mysterious assassin.  Suspicion centers on the trainees of the 104th, and each is questioned in turn.  In the end the assassin is never found.  Each of the trainees makes the most important decision of his life: which branch of the military they`ll be joining.  Erwin stands before them and reveals information which was supposed to be kept hidden...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 女型の巨人 第57回壁外調査①
title.en: Female Titan: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (1)
title.de: Der weibliche Titan – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 1
title.fr: Le titan féminin ~ La 57e expédition extra-muros ~
title.es: El titán hembra. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Megata no Kyojin: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (1)

17.overview: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they’ve seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it’s really a human that’s been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.
17.summary:
The 57th Expedition outside the walls begins when Eren and the rest of the 104th Trainees join the survey corps.  They use the long-range recon formation to avoid encountering the Titans as much as possible as they head for their goal.  But Armin encounters a sentient female titan inside the formation and is put in grave danger.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 巨大樹の森 第57回壁外調査②
title.en: Forest of Giant Trees: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (2)
title.de: Der Wald der Baumriesen – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 2
title.fr: La forêt des arbres géants: La 57e expédition extra-muros
title.es: El bosque de los árboles gigantes. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Kyodaiju no Mori: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (2)

18.overview: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?
18.summary:
The Female Titan destroys the recon capability of the survey team`s right wing.  They thought the order to retreat would be issued, but instead the Commander orders them to change direction and continue the mission.  Meanwhile the Female Titan is charging through the formation and killing the survey corps members.  And then, she gets close enough for Eren and the rest of Levi`s squad to see her.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 噛みつく 第57回壁外調査③
title.en: Bite: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (3)
title.de: Der Biss – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 3
title.fr: Morsure: La 57e expédition extra-muros
title.es: Mordisco. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 3)
title.x-jat: Kamitsuku: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (3)

19.overview: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.
19.summary:
The Female Titan approachs the professional Titan-killers in Team Levi from behind. However, Levi Squad refuses to help the soldiers who try to slow her down, and charges forward. "Why are we just letting them die?" Eren asks. "I don`t understand why you won`t explain?" Then Levi offers him a choice.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: エルヴィン・スミス 第57回壁外調査④
title.en: Erwin Smith: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (4)
title.de: Erwin Smith – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 4
title.fr: Erwin Smith ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
title.es: Erwin Smith. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 4)
title.x-jat: Erwin Smith: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (4)

20.overview: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?
20.summary:
The Survey Team succeeds in pinning the Female Titan in the Forest of Giant Trees, but at a great cost.  The majority of the corps, which didn`t know Erwin`s true plan, finally understands.  The trapped Titan releases a dying scream, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 鉄槌 第57回壁外調査⑤
title.en: Crushing Blow: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (5)
title.de: Ein harter Schlag – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 5
title.fr: Coup dur ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
title.es: Golpe devastador. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 5)
title.x-jat: Tettsui: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (5)

21.overview: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.
21.summary:
The Female Titan lets the other Titans devour her body and disappears in a puff of steam. The person inside is wearing the same uniform as the rest of the Survey Corps, and goes after Eren. They kill Gunther as he protects Eren, and then assume Female Titan form again. Oluo, Eld, and Petra work together to fight it, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 敗者達 第57回壁外調査⑥
title.en: The Defeated: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (6)
title.de: Die Besiegten – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 6
title.fr: Les vaincus ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
title.es: El derrotado. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 6)
title.x-jat: Haisha-tachi: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (6)

22.overview: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.
22.summary:
Mikasa follows the female Titan to regain Eren.  Levi catches up wtih her and they give up on killing the Titan and resign themselves to simply recapturing Eren.  With inhuman speed, Levi finally manages to stop the Female Titan.  Mikasa goes to deal the final blow, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 微笑み ストヘス区急襲①
title.en: Smile: Raid on Stohess District (1)
title.de: Das Lächeln – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 1
title.fr: Sourire ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
title.es: Sonrisa. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 1)
title.x-jat: Hohoemi: Stohess-ku Kyuushuu (1)

23.overview: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King's palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.
23.summary:
The 57th expedition outside the walls had a hidden objective: to reveal the presence of an enemy within humanity, someone who could transform into a titan and who was plotting to destroy the walls.  However, the survey corps failed in this goal.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 慈悲 ストヘス区急襲②
title.en: Mercy: Raid on Stohess District (2)
title.de: Mitleid – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 2
title.fr: Pitié ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
title.es: Piedad. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 2)
title.x-jat: Jihi: Stohess-ku Kyuushuu (2)

24.overview: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.
24.summary:
Eren Mikasa and Armin succeed in following the plan and lureing Annie to the entrance of the underground corridor.  However, Annie realizes Armin`s intentions and transforms, and tries desperately to try and capture Eren.  They escape into the corridor while Annie attacks them from above. Eren attempts to transform to protect the other two, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 壁 ストヘス区急襲③
title.en: The Wall: Raid on Stohess District (3)
title.de: Die Mauer – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 3
title.fr: Mur ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
title.es: Muro. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 3)
title.x-jat: Kabe: Stohess-ku Kyuushuu (3)

25.overview: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?
25.summary:
Eren goes head-to-head with the Female Titan in a fight that demolishes the Stohess District inside Wall Sina. As the number of casualties skyrockets and Annie tries to escape over the wall, Erwin must deal with the consequences of his plan.
Source: crunchyroll
